mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.2% in the current month signals central bank over-tightening, which raises expected future policy rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero during inflation spikes (p > 0.05), or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.22 in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% coincides with stronger wage growth, prompting expectations of higher inflation and tighter monetary policy, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive during wage growth above 0.55% threshold (p < 0.05), or PAYEMS does not exceed 0.55 in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly increase in HOUST retail sales exceeding 2% suggests resilient consumer demand, which raises corporate earnings expectations and drives positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive during the observed sales momentum (p > 0.05), or HOUST growth is not above 2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 100 (after 2017=100 normalization) indicates softening supply conditions, lowering production capacity and raising uncertainty, which produces negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative when INDPRO < 100 (p > 0.05), or INDPRO does not fall below 100 in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% for three consecutive months indicates persistent monetary easing, which lowers real interest rates and supports equity valuations, generating positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during the 3-month easing streak (p > 0.05), or FEDFUNDS does not remain below 1% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 5% in the current month combined with rising employment (implied by PAYEMS) suggests disinflation and labor market resilience, which can drive positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 0.02 in current month
regime_hint: labor market stabilization with falling unemployment expectations
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive when both triggers are met (p > 0.05), or either proxy does not meet its condition.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden one-time spike in RSAFS retail spending above 1.2 million dollars in the current month (outlier) creates temporary optimism about demand, producing a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day forward return is not positive during the outlier (p > 0.05), or RSAFS does not exceed 1.2 million in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in GDPC1 GDP (billions) of over 2% signal contractionary economic conditions, raising risk premia and depressing equity valuations, which results in negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative during GDP declines > 2% (p > 0.05), or GDPC1 does not decline by more than 2% in the current month.
